Test Case Title: Standard user can sign in successfully
Preconditions: SauceDemo reachable; browser context is fresh.
Test Steps: 1) Open login page 2) Enter standard_user / secret_sauce 3) Click Login
Expected Results: URL ends /inventory.html; Products heading and inventory cards visible.

Test Case Title: Locked-out user receives a clear authentication error
Preconditions: SauceDemo reachable; browser context is fresh.
Test Steps: 1) Open login 2) Enter locked_out_user / secret_sauce 3) Click Login
Expected Results: Login rejected; visible error says the user has been locked out.

Test Steps: 1) Sign in via authenticatedShopper fixture 2) Wait for Products and inventory 3) Read product names
Expected Results: Six products render and Sauce Labs Backpack is present.

Test Case Title: Sort products by price from low to high
Test Steps: 1) Select low-to-high price sort 2) Read displayed prices 3) Compare numeric order
Expected Results: Prices are ascending and Sauce Labs Onesie is first.

Test Case Title: Adding a product updates the cart badge
Preconditions: Authenticated user is on Inventory with an empty session cart.
Test Steps: 1) Add Sauce Labs Backpack 2) Check badge 3) Verify action changes to Remove
Expected Results: Cart badge displays 1 and the product action reads Remove.

Test Case Title: A product can be removed from the cart
Preconditions: Authenticated user; product is added before opening Cart.
Test Steps: 1) Add Backpack 2) Open Cart 3) Remove Backpack 4) Check cart contents and badge
Expected Results: Backpack is absent and cart badge disappears.

Preconditions: Standard user can sign in; checkout setup fixture can add Backpack.
Test Steps: 1) Fixture signs in and adds Backpack 2) Open checkout 3) Enter customer data 4) Verify overview/subtotal 5) Finish order
Expected Results: Overview includes Backpack and $29.99 item total; completion page says Thank you for your order!

Preconditions: Browser is logged out and login page is open.
Test Steps: 1) Leave username/password blank 2) Click Login 3) Observe validation
Expected Results: Login is blocked and required-username validation is displayed.

Test Case Title: Invalid username and password are rejected
Test Steps: 1) Enter invalid_user 2) Enter not_the_password 3) Click Login 4) Verify error and URL
Expected Results: Authentication fails; invalid-credentials error is shown; Inventory is not opened.

Test Case Title: Sort products by price from high to low
Preconditions: Signed in as standard_user; Inventory is visible.
Test Steps: 1) Open sort dropdown 2) Select Price (high to low) 3) Compare listed prices
Expected Results: Prices are in descending numeric order and highest-priced item is first.

Test Case Title: Product details open from inventory list
Test Steps: 1) Select Backpack title/image 2) Check title, description, price, button 3) Return to Inventory
Expected Results: Correct details and add-to-cart action are shown; return navigation works.

Test Case Title: Continue shopping returns from Cart to Inventory
Preconditions: Signed in; at least one product is in Cart.
Test Steps: 1) Open Cart 2) Select Continue Shopping 3) Verify Inventory 4) Check cart state
Expected Results: Returns to Inventory and existing cart state remains.

Preconditions: Signed in; Backpack in cart; checkout information page open.
Test Steps: 1) Enter first/last name 2) Leave postal code blank 3) Click Continue 4) Observe validation
Test Data: First name Alex; last name Tester; postal code blank
Expected Results: Cannot continue; postal-code required message appears.

Preconditions: Signed in as standard_user and Inventory is visible.
Test Steps: 1) Open navigation 2) Click Logout 3) Verify Login 4) Navigate directly to /inventory.html
Expected Results: Returns to Login; protected Inventory content is not accessible while logged out.

Test Case Title: Cart state remains consistent across navigation
Test Steps: 1) Add Backpack and Bike Light 2) Open Cart and check both/badge 3) Continue shopping 4) Reopen Cart
Test Data: Sauce Labs Backpack; Sauce Labs Bike Light
Expected Results: Exactly two products and badge count 2 persist through navigation.
